text: Which of the following is a strict 2-category versus a bicategory?
choices: In a strict 2-category, composition is strictly associative and unital; in a bicategory it is only so up to invertible 2-cells
In a bicategory, 2-cells must be invertible
A bicategory has only finitely many objects
explanation: Bicategories (Bénabou) relax strict 2-categories: associativity/units hold up to coherent isomorphism.
